prompt:
PLAN 02 | THE FIRST COMMAND WORKS
DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9
CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_JAMSHID_WORKER}}  {{CHAR_DOCK_WORKERS}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_WORKING_QUAY}}
PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_CARGO_HOIST}}  {{PROP_MOORING_ROPE}}
DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY
Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
Cold neutral overcast daylight with water bounce. Preserve the referenced hoist, crate, bollards and level loading area. Light stays constant during the command; authority comes from posture and camera organization.
START STATE AND BLOCKING
A low suspended crate is slowly slipping as its control line runs through a worn brake. Worker A stands by the brake, Worker B by a fixed bollard. Jamshid is landward of the load, outside its path. The crate remains over a clear loading zone.

PLAN 02 | SHOTS
SHOT 02-01 | 0s–3s | 3 SECONDS
50mm close from beside the brake: the control rope slips, the pulley rotates and the crate drops a few centimeters in the background. Worker A grabs the control lever, uncertain. Handheld camera reacts to the rope jerk.
SHOT 02-02 | 3s–8s | 5 SECONDS
35mm medium at slightly low chest height from landward. Jamshid straightens immediately. He raises his RIGHT hand to shoulder height, elbow bent, palm outward, fingers together: a precise stop command. Hold this recognizable gesture briefly. He then points Worker A to hold the brake and Worker B toward the bollard. Camera settles into a deliberate short physical push.
SHOT 02-03 | 8s–12s | 4 SECONDS
28mm side view including both stations. Worker A holds the brake lever firmly while Worker B adds a friction wrap around the bollard. Their coordinated actions arrest the rope. The crate stops drifting and is lowered the final few centimeters onto its support.
SHOT 02-04 | 12s–15s | 3 SECONDS
50mm medium from the same landward side as the command, now closer. The grounded crate stays visible beyond Jamshid. His right hand lowers only after the load is stable. His body remains upright and certain; workers resume their tasks.
END STATE AND EDIT
The crate rests safely on the quay. The successful command is unmistakable. Jamshid remains upright near the secured load, right hand lowered.
SOUND
Rope accelerating, pulley rattle, strained wood, hurried shoes, brake friction and a dull cargo landing. Work sounds continue after the solution.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.
